exposure: frequent premature ventricular complexes or non-sustained ventricular tachycardia (VA)
outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Women admitted in labor with structurally normal hearts
finding: The presence of arrhythmias, specifically SVT and AF, during labor in women with structurally normal hearts was independently associated with adverse obstetrical outcomes, including cesarean section, preterm labor, and longer hospital stays.
mod_finding: The presence of any arrhythmia was an independent predictor of cesarean section.
